# SDK

Plain HTML and CSS driven from your program: open windows, load pages, react to events, update the page, use native dialogs, the clipboard and live bitmaps. Full control, no extra layer. The UI library is built on it.

It works the same on Linux and Windows; the few real differences are listed in [Linux and Windows](../getting-started/platforms.md).

-   **[Python](python/index.md)**
